statement: The assessment that distinction (2) 'may reduce to existing KG-neighborhood augmentation' is inaccurate as stated: same-passage provenance corresponds to a different established line (KG construction from text / text graphs / OIE-KB triple alignment), not to KG-neighborhood retrieval. The distinction is therefore not under-specified in the sense of being unstudied; it is well-defined but crowded prior art, and its use as a fine-tuning supervision signal remains the only unoccupied part.

evidence.quote: essentially constructing text graphs rather than true knowledge graphs
Many of these downstream tasks rely on aligning OIE triples with reference KBs.
